claim_truth.subject: Termination of Employment Policy

object.value: applies to all regular full-time and part-time staff employees

claim_truth.evidence_quote: This policy applies to all regular full- time and part- time staff employees, including those holding term appointments.

claim_truth.subject: Employees

object.value: minimum of two weeks' written notice

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Employees who decide to leave the University are asked to provide their immediate supervisor with a reasonable notice period, preferably a minimum of two weeks' written notice.

claim_truth.subject: Termination for serious misconduct
claim_truth.evidence_quote: Termination for serious misconduct may occur without prior notice in accordance with the University's Corrective Action Policy for Staff Employees

claim_truth.subject: Staff members terminated for misconduct
claim_truth.evidence_quote: Staff mem bers term inated for misco nduct are not eligible for severance pay.

claim_truth.subject: position elimination

object.value: position is eliminated or its duties change by more than 50%

claim_truth.evidence_quote: A position elimination occurs when a position is eliminate d or its duties change by more than 50%.

claim_truth.subject: supervisors

object.value: may not rehire the position for a period of at least one year

claim_truth.evidence_quote: supervisors may not rehire the position fo r a period of at least one year, except with the approval of the chief human resources officer.

claim_truth.subject: final paycheck

object.value: includes all unpaid wages, earned but unused paid leave time (PLT)

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The final paycheck includes all unpaid wages, earned but unused paid l eave time (PLT) for non-exempt staff

claim_truth.subject: Supervisors

object.value: as soon as they are aware an employee is voluntarily terminating

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Supervisors should notify the designated Human Resources partner as soon as they are aware an employee is voluntarily terminating.

claim_truth.subject: Retiring employees

object.value: advance notice of their intention to retire

claim_truth.evidence_quote: To help assist in a transition, employees are asked to give advance notice of their intention to retire.

claim_truth.subject: Terminations for Unsatisfactory Performance

object.value: expected to follow the University's Corrective Action Policy for Staff Employees

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Before terminating an employee for unsatisfactory performance, supervisors are generally expected to follow the University's Corrective Action Policy for Staff Employees.
